question: What disciplined practice over six months leads toward freedom from bondage?
premises: Practice is prescribed for six months
The practitioner undertakes a renunciant discipline
The aim is freedom from bondage
inference: One who practices for six months in that renunciant, bondage-free discipline advances accordingly.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of kāṣāyaṃ is interpreted as part of the prescribed discipline.
plain_english: Whoever practices for six months, embracing the ochre discipline free from bondage...
